item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 08/Apr/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The northeast monsoon affecting the coast of southern China will moderate gradually in the next couple of days. A humid easterly airstream is expected to affect the coast of Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week. Temperatures will rise over the region.

Date/Month: 09/04 (Sunday)
Wind: East force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 offshore at first.
Weather: Sunny periods. Dry during the day.
Temp range: 19 - 24 C
R.H. range: 55 - 75 per Cent
PSR: Low
